entry.title: B-52 To Get Stealthy AGM-158C Long-Range Anti-Ship Missiles
entry.summary: The U.S. Navy is preparing to sign a contract with Lockheed Martin to integrate the stealthy AGM-158C Long Range Anti-Ship Missile (LRASM) onto the Air Force’s B-52 Stratofortress bombers, according to an October 7 government notice. The effort would add another long-range maritime strike option to the U.S. bomber force as the military looks to counter increasingly capable adversary naval forces, especially in the Indo-Pacific theater. U.S. Willis The latest Naval Air Systems Command (NAVAIR) notice says the command intends to enter into sole-source negotiations with Lockheed Martin and subsequently award a cost-plus-fixed-fee delivery order covering LRASM integration on the B-52. The B-52 can carry up to 20 JASSMs, and the weapons have the same dimensions, but the government notice does not specify how many LRASMs the bomber would ultimately carry. A B-52 flies across the Atlantic Ocean on June 17, 2019, for a flight in support of Exercise BALTOPS 2019, the largest multinational maritime exercise of the year in the Baltic Sea. The U.S. Air Force’s Fiscal Year 2027 budget proposal further outlines plans to integrate the latest variants of LRASM and JASSM onto the B-52, including versions not yet cleared for use on the bomber. Planned work in FY2027 includes incorporating the missiles’ operational flight programs into the B-52’s baseline bomber software, validating safe weapon separation from both wing-mounted stations and the internal carriage launcher, updating armament interfaces, and completing system-safety testing. 关键事实：according to an October 7 government notice；The effort would add another long-range maritime strike option to the U.S

entry.title: First Look At Hypersonic Boost-Glide Vehicle Just Tested By South Korea
entry.summary: The South Korean government has released images from its first successful test of a domestically developed hypersonic boost-glide vehicle. This includes shots of the vehicle impacting the water at the end of its flight. A weapon of this kind would give South Korea a significant new way to hold targets in North Korea at risk amid an ever-deepening arms race on the Peninsula . A trio of pictures showing South Korea’s new hypersonic boost-glide vehicle impacting the water during the test yesterday. The Blue House Another view of the impact at the end of yesterday’s South Korea hypersonic test as seen through what looks to be an electro-optical video camera on an aircraft. The Blue House As mentioned, there are also pictures of the hypersonic boost-glide vehicle hitting the water. Another close-up look at the hypersonic boost-glide vehicle test yesterday, showing what looks to be a truncated fin on one side. “The HGV [hypersonic boost-glide vehicle] successfully separated after ascending to the target altitude and executed its planned flight path within the hypersonic environment without any issues.” With all this in mind, the fact that the vehicle just remained intact through to impact is noteworthy. At the time of writing, South Korean authorities do not appear to have disclosed more specific details about the test, including how far the boost-glide vehicle traveled before hitting the water or what peak speed it reached. 关键事实：The South Korean government has released images from its first successful test of a domestically developed hypersonic boost-glide vehicle；This includes shots of the vehicle impacting the water at the end of its flight

entry.title: Flydubai co-pilot planned suicide attack on Israeli airport, UAE prosecutors say
entry.summary: The co-pilot who tried to seize control of a passenger jet flying from Dubai to Tel Aviv last week was planning to launch a suicide attack targeting the passenger terminal at Israel’s international airport, prosecutors in the United Arab Emirates said on Friday. Passengers then tried to control the aircraft, which was safely landed in Saudi Arabia by an off-duty relief pilot who was among about 180 passengers. Dr Hamad Saif al-Shamsi, attorney-general of the UAE, said on Friday that al-Hammami, who is in Emirate custody, had admitted he had tried to execute a “premeditated terrorist plot to … launch a suicide attack targeting the passenger terminal at Ben Gurion airport near Tel Aviv, with the aim of causing the greatest possible loss of life”. The 29-year-old, who was hired by flydubai, a government-owned low-cost airline, began a process of radicalisation while studying in Australia when he was influenced by the hardline takfiri ideology through reading extremist literature and online content glorifying terrorist organisations and suicide attacks, al-Shamsi said in a statement. 关键事实：prosecutors in the United Arab Emirates said on Friday；Passengers then tried to control the aircraft

entry.title: Guest Post: Quantum Computing’s Transistor Moment
entry.summary: The first is a transistor moment. In 2020, researchers in Leipzig, Germany, demonstrated the first working one-qubit diamond-based quantum computer – proof that the device physics worked outside a research setting. In 2023, fabrication of NV centers was demonstrated at production scale under Germany’s national quantum computing initiative – the “transistor” manufactured repeatably rather than hand-assembled one defect at a time. That figure deserves attention because almost no competing spin-defect platform has published a fabrication yield at all, and yield is the industrial question – how reliably usable qubits can be placed where they are wanted, at scale. Diamond – The Silicon of Quantum Computing? Whether NV-center diamond is quantum computing’s silicon – the material system that wins the platform war – is an open question. Silicon-vacancy and tin-vacancy centers in diamond have so far worked only at cryogenic temperatures, and other spin centers could eventually prove better. 关键事实：The first is a transistor moment；researchers in Leipzig；demonstrated the first working one-qubit diamond-based quantum computer – proof that the device physics worked outside a research setting

entry.title: Three Saudi nationals killed in Houthi attacks on Riyadh airport
entry.summary: Three Saudi Arabian nationals have been killed in two attacks on the international airport in the capital, Riyadh, the country's civil aviation authority has said, after Yemen's Houthis said they had targeted the facility. The attacks also resulted in "injuries to a number of Saudi citizens and residents of various nationalities", the General Authority of Civil Aviation said in a statement on X. It added that the first attack on Thursday targeted the airport while the second had struck an aircraft belonging to state carrier Saudia. One of its pilots was among those killed, the airline said in a statement. Air traffic had returned to normal, the civil aviation authority said. Yemen's Houthi group said on Thursday it had attacked the airport with two ballistic missiles. The Iran-aligned group said it had also targeted an airport in Najran city near the Saudi border with Yemen, and Khamis Mushait air base further north. Saudi Arabia has not confirmed these attacks. The latest casualties follow the deaths of three people in Houthi attacks on two Saudi airports on 6 and 7 October. Two were killed and 28 wounded in an attack at Abha International Airport, the civil aviation body said on Wednesday. Another person was killed at King Khalid airport in Riyadh. The latest attacks come amid a marked escalation in renewed fighting between Yemen's Saudi-backed government forces and the Houthis, who control most of the country's north-west. 关键事实：Three Saudi Arabian nationals have been killed in two attacks on the international airport in the capital；the country's civil aviation authority has said；after Yemen's Houthis said they had targeted the facility

entry.title: Estonia’s KrattWorks crafting Shahed-like dummy drone for target practice
entry.summary: WARSAW, Poland — Estonian unmanned aerial system producer KrattWorks is developing a new aerial target drone that will mimic the operations of jet-powered Shahed-type drones, enabling militaries to practice shooting down one of the main aerial threats used by Russia in its ongoing invasion of Ukraine. Ranno Pajuri, business development manager at KrattWorks, told Defense News the new dummy drone is expected to be presented by the end of 2027.

entry.title: NASA Seeks US Industry Plans for Commercial Space Stations
entry.summary: Credit: NASA NASA is advancing American leadership in space by taking the next step toward a future where commercial space stations lead the way in low Earth orbit. On Friday, the agency released its final Request for Proposals inviting industry to submit plans for the next generation of commercial space stations. “In alignment with the President’s National Space Policy, NASA is committed to maintaining a sustained American presence in low Earth orbit long after the International Space Station retires,” said NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman. 关键事实：the agency released its final Request for Proposals inviting industry to submit plans for the next generation of commercial space stations；“In alignment with the President’s National Space Policy

entry.title: EOS lands nationwide C-UAS contract with Gulf state
entry.summary: Electro Optic Systems Holdings Limited (EOS) has entered into an agreement with the government of a Middle Eastern Gulf state (a Gulf Co-operation Council member) for the provision of a nationwide, counter-uncrewed aerial system (C-UAS) defence system valued at GBP 370 million. EOS said on 9 October that this is the largest contract the company has secured. The company’s NiDAR C-UAS system, acquired as part of the recent MARSS acquisition, is central to the contract. It is an AI-enabled command and control system (C2), designed specifically for C-UAS defence, covering both airborne and coastal seaborne drone detection. The contract requires the rapid deployment of a cellular, nationwide C-UAS system with NiDAR C2. EOS is acting as the prime contractor and systems integrator. 关键事实：EOS said on 9 October that this is the largest contract the company has secured

entry.title: NASA Demonstrates Next-Generation Heat Shield Technologies
entry.summary: The capsules will carry a variety of thermal protective components, including proven technology such as the ceramic tile material used on the space shuttle. Others will test new options, such as a 3D-printed heat shield from the Additive Manufacturing of Thermal Protective Systems project developed at NASA Johnson and Oak Ridge National Laboratory. Researchers at NASA Ames are contributing several materials to KREPE-3, including two capsules that will fly a next-generation family of protective coverings known as Materials Engineered for Re-entry using Innovative Needling Operations (MERINO). 关键事实：The capsules will carry a variety of thermal protective components；Others will test new options

entry.title: OpenAI revenue keeps surging as company seeks $30 billion in fresh capital
entry.summary: The company is negotiating at least $30 billion in new capital at a target pre-money valuation of $1.4 trillion. In March, OpenAI raised up to $122 billion at a post-money valuation of $852 billion. 关键事实：The company is negotiating at least $30 billion in new capital at a target pre-money valuation of $1.4 trillion；OpenAI raised up to $122 billion at a post-money valuation of $852 billion
